question: What Are the Types of Conveyor Safety Switches?
body_html:
Conveyor safety switches detect dangerous conditions on a belt conveyor and open the interlock circuit to stop the drive.

SwitchDetectsSensing method
Pull cordPerson in dangerWire rope along the belt
Belt swayBelt misalignmentRoller lever at belt edge
Zero speedBelt slip or breakageSensor on tail pulley rotation
Chute jamBlocked transfer chuteTilt or probe switch
Belt rip detectorLongitudinal belt tearsMaterial falling through belt

A pull cord switch latches after tripping and must be reset by hand at the switch.
